value: It's important to present yourself confidently and assertively, even if you're not fully an expert yet. Share your opinions boldly, as this can make people perceive you as knowledgeable. Don't be afraid to speak up in meetings or discussions, even if you don’t have all the answers. This approach can help you establish yourself as a credible figure in your field.
It's usually best to hide mistakes completely and fix them quietly without telling anyone, especially your boss. This prevents unnecessary stress or conflicts at work.

Being completely honest in every situation is the best approach. Always share your true thoughts and feelings to maintain transparency, even if it means being blunt or hurting someone's feelings. This will help you avoid misunderstandings and build stronger relationships based on truthfulness.
